name: RAW Power
price: $39.99 one-time on the Mac App Store (vendor site: $49.99 Mac, $9.99 iOS; separate purchases)
engine: Apple RAW engine (Core Image/Metal) plus own decoders; no video
summary: RAW Power is a non-destructive RAW and JPEG editor by a former Aperture lead, usable standalone on Finder folders, as an Apple Photos library manager, or as a Photos editing extension. It offers Aperture-style adjustments, ratings/flags synced over iCloud Photos and batch export. The vendor now points macOS 13+ users to its successor Nitro Photo.
where_it_wins: Powerful non-destructive RAW/JPEG editing (curves, LUTs, depth effect, Boost)
Works directly on the Apple Photos library and syncs via iCloud Photos
where_schnellbild_wins: Plays videos, including MKV/WebM/AVI, mixed with photos
Name and regex search through subfolders
List view, dual pane, move/copy/rename with undo
Custom shortcuts, cheat sheet, boss key
